thread:
maria: FYI customer report: observed duplicated billing when a streaming session fell back mid-request. Pattern: stream reconnect -> router routes to fallback shard -> an embedded toolcall executes on fallback -> later the final confirmation arrives on primary and we end up with both provisional stream tokens + final toolcall tokens. Repro trace and logs below. tagging @alex @li

alex: Can you paste the trace ids + a screenshot of the metering rows? We pushed that provisional/confirmed UX a week ago.

maria: Pasted redacted snippets:
```
TRACE: sid=rb-23-77 resume_token=rt-900 route=primary->fallback toolcall=tc-314
STREAM_CHUNK: prefix_tokens=27 truncated=true provisional_tokens=27 prov_id=prov-A12
TOOLCALL_EXEC: id=tc-314 parent_session=rb-23-77
TOOLCALL_ACK: id=tc-314 confirmed_tokens=24 ack_id=ack-Z99
LEDGER_WRITE: provisional_id=prov-A12 applied=true
LEDGER_WRITE: confirmed_id=conf-B77 applied=true
```
maria: Console shows two metering rows (prov-A12 then conf-B77). Customer billed for sum(prov, conf) before reconcile.

li: My hunch: final ack routed a different path that lacked tombstone metadata, so ledger dedupe logic treated confirmed as new. Did the tombstone propagation change in last router refactor?

dave: We shortened tombstone retention to 30s in the recent canary to reduce storage growth. :grimacing:

sophia: Short-term mitigation: make final ack carry parent_provisional_id when known so ledger can dedupe deterministically. Long-term: ensure tombstone propagation across routes.

alex: Two-prong plan: (A) telemetry + console alerting to surface likely duplicate-charge events to CS and refunds pipeline, (B) ledger change to accept parent_provisional_id on confirmation for idempotent applies. The UI change improves detection but doesn't stop immediate charge.

maria: Customers filed tickets already. Need hotfix + medium term.

li: I'll emit a new telemetry event charge_suspect with fields: session_id, prov_ids (array), final_ack, route_chain. That lets us build a quick dashboard and export CSV for accounting.

dave: I'll roll back the tombstone TTL change on the canary to 5m; low-risk and should cut the window significantly. Rolling back now.

sophia: I'll draft a ledger spec: accept optional parent_provisional_id on toolcall-confirm RPC; reconciler will check tombstone table first then fallback to parent id matching before applying confirmed credits. Also include metrics for dedupe hits/misses.

alex: Next steps: li -> telemetry event + grafana query; dave -> rollback canary TTL and watch canary; maria -> file BUG-4721 with artifacts + customer refs; sophia -> spec PR for ledger change.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for service=router by dave at 1702510084 :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks, folks. Adding to tomorrow's metering sync for prioritization and refund runbook. :thumbsup:
